notes.title: "Dragon Summon" update V0.0.109, multiple old card ad
notes.notes:
1 Monkey skill 3 bug modification
2 Introduction to qualifying rewards
3 Introducing the rewards of each tower
4 The man-machine Monkey King still hasn't been repaired, he burns the rope every day
5 The screen is always on
6 Old card modification
● Night Watchman Kelly 7062 is reworked as 3-3-3 [Appearance] Destroy the creatures with [Hidden] in the opposite position.
● Trendy Man Fak 7060 is reworked as [Death Word] Turn a grave on your side into a 2/2 "one-eyed guard" with [sarcasm].
● Malcis 7047 is reworked as 10-10-10 Concealed [Appearance] Exchange the health of both heroes [Present] The damage suffered by your own hero is borne by "Malcis".
● Rock Demon Sardins 6032 Increase [Attacked] This creature's immunity is less than 3 damage.
● Small Match 100018 is adjusted to 3-2-1 and the description is changed to Ash [Death Word] randomly controls a creature with the lowest health value on the enemy field.
● Froda 3016 is reworked as [Appearance] Summon two 3/1 "Ghost Riders" with [Ash] and [First Strike] on your own field (priority covering the grave).
● Sinclair 3015 is reworked as 5 Mana Divine Shield [Appearance] Destroy the creature with the highest attack power on the enemy's field and gain its attack power.
● Lawrence 2015 is reworked as 4 mana. Healing 2 [Appearance] Swaps health with the creature with the highest health on the enemy's field.
● Forbidden Words 26 is reworked to silence all creatures on the enemy's field.
● Kurori 7016 is reworked. At the beginning of both rounds, it will cause 3 damage to all other characters.
● Encapsulated Heart 523 adjusted to 4 mana. Reworked. When a creature on your side of the field dies, shuffle it into the library by copying it (only works for creatures of purple or higher quality).
● Gate of Rebirth 57 The cost is reduced to 1, and the description is changed to designate a creature on your side of the field to return it to your hand (maintain its original state and attributes).
● Soul Re-engraving 48 The cost is reduced to 3, and the description is changed to a creature on the designated field, copied to the empty slot on your side of the field (maintaining the original state and attributes).
● Ice Blast 43 is reworked to destroy all frozen creatures on the enemy's field.
● Frost Nova 40 is reworked to freeze all enemy characters.
● Betsy Hound 4001 Increase the first attack entry, the attack is reduced to 1, the life is reduced to 2
● Laziness 100031 Newly added [Death Language] Both sides discard a hand card.
● Gluttony 100034 is reworked as [Death Whisper] to halve the summon value of a random undead creature card in the hand (rounded down).
● Silent Prison Pillar 100032 is reworked as a taunt [Grave is present] The enemy will not be able to draw cards (including card deal, hero skills and card special effects for each round).
